command: Craswell et al. 2021, SIGIR, doi:10.1145/3404835.3463249, Sec. 3.2: the 2019 judgment process was reused in 2020; thresholds from the 2019 overview (arXiv 2003.07820)
name: TREC DL 2020 passage
note: The 2020 overview does not state the topic rule; the companion SIGIR paper (Craswell et al. 2021, Sec. 3.2) says the 2019 judgment process was reused, so the card checks the 2019 thresholds.

pilot.evaluation_protocol: NDCG@10 (main), AP, RR over 8.8M passages; unjudged = non-relevant
pilot.negative_source: measured (judged grade 0-1) plus implicit (unjudged passages scored non-relevant by trec_eval)
pilot.notes: recoded 2026-10-19 (prior-work check): first coded text_sufficient = no and decidability partial because the 2020 overview does not state the rule; the companion SIGIR paper states that the 2019 process was reused
pilot.rule_found_in_code_or_release: 54 topics in qrels; consistent with the stated rule: 0 with < 3 relevant (min exactly 3), 0 with ratio >= 0.6 (max 0.350)
pilot.rule_stated_in_paper: the 2020 overview says only that NIST chose a subset of the queries for judging (54 passage topics); the companion SIGIR paper (Sec. 3.2) states 'The same judgment process was used in 2020' as in 2019: candidates chosen by the median MRR of document runs (excluded if > 0.5 or 0.0), and candidates dropped when their number of relevant documents fell outside the range; the thresholds are the 2019 overview's (>= 3 relevant, relevant/judged < 0.6); Voorhees et al. 2022 describe the density cut as 'more than one half'
pilot.sources_checked: Craswell et al. 2021 overview (arXiv 2102.07662, Sec. 2); Craswell, Mitra, Yilmaz, Campos, Voorhees & Soboroff 2021, SIGIR 2369-2375, doi:10.1145/3404835.3463249 (arXiv 2104.09399, Sec. 3.2 'Test Sets'); Craswell et al. 2020 overview for the 2019 thresholds; Voorhees, Craswell & Lin 2022, SIGIR, doi:10.1145/3477495.3531728; 2020qrels-pass.txt (trec.nist.gov); msmarco-test2020-queries.tsv.gz
pilot.verification: evaluation-set rule checked on the qrels (max relevant/judged 0.350, so the 'more than one half' density wording also holds); the median-MRR pre-selection needs the submitted runs (not checked)
